session_summary: Blue title bar: 'Spike and Channel Bear Trend'. Reading: open near 3560 sold off all morning — the early wedge bottom failed, the spike and channel bear trend extended with an extremely climactic huge bear bar at 08:20 into 3455 ('Expect 2 legs sideways to up'), an ii compression was flagged as a possible final flag but resolved down, and the channel (pink dotted falling wedge lines) stepped down with wedge/DT retests (3495, 3470, plus a 20 gap-bar sell at the 12:40 LH) to the 3425 low; the day then delivered its two legs sideways-to-up with a rally into the 3465 close (green entry boxes at 13:00). Plain-PT style 9/3 to 9/4 edge marker.
